Description:
  This well-appointed 1-bedroom residence offers 833.12 sqft of thoughtfully designed living space, delivering a refined balance of comfort, functionality, and modern elegance. The layout is efficiently planned to maximize usable space and natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere suitable for both end-users and investors seeking strong long-term value.


  The apartment features an open-plan living and dining area that flows seamlessly into a contemporary kitchen fitted with quality finishes and practical storage solutions. The bedroom is spacious and well-proportioned, complete with built-in wardrobes and large windows that enhance natural light while maintaining privacy. The bathroom is designed with modern fittings and a clean, sophisticated aesthetic, ensuring both style and functionality.


  Strategically located within a well-connected community, the property provides convenient access to key business districts, retail destinations, and major road networks, ensuring seamless daily commuting and urban convenience. It represents a strong investment opportunity with high rental demand and attractive yield potential.
